The Sahabah (RA) Prefer the Pleasure of Rasulullaah ﷺ to their Own Pleasure
Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) Weeps when his Father Embraces Islaam because of his Keenness for Abu Taalib to Accept Islaam.

In the narration discussing how Hadhrat Abu Quhaafah (RA) (the father of Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA)) accepted Islaam, Hadhrat Anas (RA) reports that when Hadhrat Abu Quhaafah (RA) stretched out his hands to pledge allegiance to Rasulullaah ﷺ, Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) started to cry. "What makes you cry?" Rasulullaah ﷺ asked. Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) replied, "It would have been more pleasing for me to see the hand of your uncle (Abu Taalib) in the place of my father's hand and him accepting Islaam instead so that Allaah could please you in that manner."[^2]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) narrates that on the day that Makkah was conquered, Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) led his aged and blind father Hadhrat Abu Quhaafah (RA) to Rasulullaah ﷺ (to accept Islaam). Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Why did you not leave the old man in his house and let me go to him?" Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) replied, "I wanted him to be rewarded for it. O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Had your uncle Abu Taalib accepted Islaam, it would have made me happier then my father's embracing Islaam because your happiness is all I wish to see." Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "You are true (in your words because this is really what you feel)."[^3]
The Incident between Hadhrat Umar (RA) and Hadhrat Abbaas (RA)

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) narrates that amongst the captives of the Battle of Badr was Hadhrat Abbaas bin Abdul Muttalib (RA). A man from the Ansaar captured him and the other Ansaar threatened to kill him. Because this news reached Rasulullaah ﷺ, he said, "I was unable to sleep last night because the Ansaar have said that they would kill my uncle Abbaas." "Should I go to the Ansaar (and fetch Hadhrat Abbaas (RA))?" Hadhrat Umar (RA) offered. When Rasulullaah ﷺ bade him to do so, he went to them and said, "Release Abbaas."
